1.w: Give thanks to the Lord . Call on his name. Make known his accomplishments among the nations.

2.w: Sing to him. Make music to him. Tell about all his miraculous deeds.

3.w: Boast about his holy name. Let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

4.w: Seek the Lord and the strength he gives. Seek his presence continually.

5.w: Recall the miraculous deeds he performed, his mighty acts and the judgments he decreed,

6.w: O children of Abraham, God’s servant, you descendants of Jacob, God’s chosen ones.

7.w: He is the Lord our God; he carries out judgment throughout the earth.

8.w: He always remembers his covenantal decree, the promise he made to a thousand generations—

9.w: the promise he made to Abraham, the promise he made by oath to Isaac.

10.w: He gave it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as a lasting promise,

11.w: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”

12.w: When they were few in number, just a very few, and resident foreigners within it,

13.w: they wandered from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another.

14.w: He let no one oppress them; he disciplined kings for their sake,

15.w: saying, “Don’t touch my chosen ones. Don’t harm my prophets.”

16.w: He called down a famine upon the earth; he cut off all the food supply.

17.w: He sent a man ahead of them — Joseph was sold as a servant.

18.w: The shackles hurt his feet; his neck was placed in an iron collar,

19.w: until the time when his prediction came true. The Lord ’s word proved him right.

20.w: The king authorized his release; the ruler of nations set him free.

21.w: He put him in charge of his palace, and made him manager of all his property,

22.w: giving him authority to imprison his officials and to teach his advisers.

23.w: Israel moved to Egypt; Jacob lived for a time in the land of Ham.

24.w: The Lord made his people very fruitful and made them more numerous than their enemies.

25.w: He caused the Egyptians to hate his people and to mistreat his servants.

26.w: He sent his servant Moses, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

27.w: They executed his miraculous signs among them and his amazing deeds in the land of Ham.

28.w: He made it dark; Moses and Aaron did not disobey his orders.

29.w: He turned the Egyptians’ water into blood and killed their fish.

30.w: Their land was overrun by frogs, which even got into the rooms of their kings.

31.w: He ordered flies to come; gnats invaded their whole territory.

32.w: He sent hail along with the rain; there was lightning in their land.

33.w: He destroyed their vines and fig trees and broke the trees throughout their territory.

34.w: He ordered locusts to come, innumerable grasshoppers.

35.w: They ate all the vegetation in their land and devoured the crops of their fields.

36.w: He struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of their reproductive power.

37.w: He brought his people out enriched with silver and gold; none of his tribes stumbled.

38.w: Egypt was happy when they left, for they were afraid of them.

39.w: He spread out a cloud for a cover, and provided a fire to light up the night.

40.w: They asked for food, and he sent quail; he satisfied them with food from the sky.

41.w: He opened up a rock and water flowed out; a river ran through dry regions.

42.w: Yes, he remembered the sacred promise he made to Abraham his servant.

43.w: When he led his people out, they rejoiced; his chosen ones shouted with joy.

44.w: He handed the territory of nations over to them, and they took possession of what other peoples had produced,

45.w: so that they might keep his commands and obey his laws. Praise the Lord .
